question: On a patient-grouped public PAD-UFES-20 split, does adding clinical metadata to image features improve six-class skin-lesion classification?
scope: Independent retrospective research demonstration; no diagnosis or clinical deployment.

data.orientation: Stored decoded RGB orientation; no EXIF transpose. Exact RGB duplicate grouping only; near duplicates not guaranteed absent.
data.identifier_audit: 250 lesion_id values map to multiple patient IDs. Conservatively union those patients before splitting; may over-group unrelated records.

preprocessing: Train-only numeric imputation/scaling and categorical vocabulary; unknown/missing categories explicit. Frozen ImageNet ResNet18 encoder with official resize/crop normalization. Exact RGB duplicates are joined into patient components before split.

training.loss: class-weighted cross entropy using train counts
training.selection: lowest inner-tune weighted cross entropy per model/seed; restore checkpoint; outer validation only after selection freeze, test separately unlocked
training.batch_policy: balanced chunks with all rows retained; no singleton trailing batch
training.inner_tune: 20% target-free component hash within the 60% outer-training partition; no retrain on tune
training.missing_class_policy: stop if fit or inner-tune lacks a class; no post-label seed/split search

evaluation.uncertainty: 200 paired patient/reused-lesion-ID/exact-RGB-duplicate component bootstrap replicates; mean per-seed metric, conditional on fixed split and fitted models
evaluation.primary_comparison: concat-linear minus image-linear macro-F1 (prespecified metadata increment)
evaluation.secondary_comparisons: MetaBlock and HEALNet vs concat-linear, exploratory architecture comparisons, no test-selected winner
evaluation.test_unlock: Separate independent hash-bound execute-only review after frozen selection

absent_class_policy.macro_f1: six fixed labels, zero_division=0, supports displayed
absent_class_policy.balanced_accuracy: mean recall over classes present in evaluated sample
absent_class_policy.macro_auroc: null unless all six classes present; no silent bootstrap exclusion

stop_conditions: missing class in fit or inner-tune

permissions.training: requires instrumented smoke and independent execute-only review
permissions.outer_validation: locked until selection frozen and separate independent execute-only review

architectures.linear: Linear pooled frozen image features and/or encoded metadata -> six logits

metablock.pool: spatial mean after official MetaBlock gating
